scenes.say: Se um apocalipse zumbi começasse hoje... você sobreviveria trinta dias? Dia um.
scenes.prompt: Wide establishing shot of a big Brazilian city at dawn seen from an apartment balcony: dense apartment towers, favela houses on a hill, a highway; several thick columns of dark smoke rising, a military helicopter in the sky, tiny panicked figures in the streets far below. In the foreground, the stick figure character with the mustard-yellow bucket hat stands on the balcony seen from behind, looking at the city. Ominous orange-grey sky.

scenes.say: Você acorda com quarenta e sete notificações e sirenes por toda a cidade.
scenes.prompt: Small simple Brazilian bedroom at early morning, dim. The stick figure character with the mustard-yellow bucket hat sits up in bed holding a glowing smartphone, eyes wide, surprised. Red and blue police siren light shines through the window blinds onto the wall. A fan, a football poster, clothes on a chair.

scenes.say: Na TV, uma única frase: fiquem em casa. Não abram a porta pra ninguém.
scenes.prompt: Brazilian apartment living room. Over-the-shoulder view from behind the stick figure character with the mustard-yellow bucket hat sitting on a worn sofa, facing a TV on a rack. On the TV screen a stick figure news anchor at a desk with a big red breaking-news banner that reads exactly 'URGENTE: FIQUEM EM CASA'. The TV glow lights the dark room.

scenes.say: Da janela, você vê um motoboy caído no meio da rua. Ele levanta... torto. E morde o primeiro que passa.
scenes.prompt: High angle view from a third-floor window down onto a Brazilian street: a fallen delivery motorbike, a delivery rider zombie in an orange jacket and black helmet getting up crookedly in the middle of the street, a stopped city bus, people (stick figures) running away in panic, an abandoned food delivery box. The window frame is visible at the edges.

Dramatic close action shot on a Brazilian street: the zombie delivery rider in the orange jacket and black helmet lunges with arms forward at a terrified stick figure man in a business shirt who drops his coffee and briefcase. Motion lines, dynamic angle. Cartoonish, no blood, no gore.

scenes.say: Você tranca tudo, empurra o sofá na porta e conta o que tem: dois miojos e meia garrafa d'água. Se você quer saber se sobrevive, segue o perfil: ainda faltam vinte e nove dias.
scenes.prompt: Inside a small Brazilian apartment: the stick figure character with the mustard-yellow bucket hat, sweating and determined, pushes a heavy sofa against the front door. In the foreground on a kitchen table: exactly two packets of instant noodles and one plastic water bottle half full. Morning light, tense mood.

scenes.say: Meio-dia. Batidas na porta. É o seu Jorge, do três zero dois: abre, pelo amor de Deus! Eu só fui arranhado!
scenes.prompt: Fisheye view through a door peephole into a dim apartment building hallway: an older neighbor stick figure (bald round white head, grey mustache, white tank top, shorts, flip-flops) stands very close to the door, pale and sweaty, desperate face, his forearm wrapped in a stained t-shirt. Circular vignette of the peephole, dark edges.

scenes.say: Pelo olho mágico, o braço dele tá enrolado numa camiseta. Aí as batidas param... e começa um arranhado lento na porta.
scenes.prompt: Inside the dark apartment entrance: the stick figure character with the mustard-yellow bucket hat presses his back against the barricaded front door, terrified, eyes wide, sweat drops. Under the door, a shadow of two feet. Thin light from the hallway through the gap. Very tense.

scenes.say: Às oito da noite, a cidade inteira apaga. E no escuro... o arranhado continua.
scenes.prompt: Night. Big Brazilian city skyline in a total blackout seen through the apartment window: every building dark, only moonlight and a few distant fires. The stick figure character with the mustard-yellow bucket hat stands in the dark room in silhouette, holding a single lit candle, looking back over his shoulder at the front door.

scenes.say: Comenta: você teria aberto a porta?
